verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party SSO plugin documents support for OpenID Connect, OAuth2 providers and SAML 2.0, which is the core of connecting enterprise identity providers for workforce sign-in. The homepage pitches it as enterprise-ready with SSO, SAML 2.0, SCIM and directory sync, and a community commenter independently says it covers SAML/SCIM, though they note some of those features are enterprise-only. Missing for 10: no documented setup for Okta, Entra or Google Workspace specifically, little detail on SAML/OIDC configuration depth, no hands-on reports of workforce SSO in use, and it is unclear which SSO features sit behind the enterprise tier.
